name: Class Action
definition: Form of lawsuit in which a group of shareholders collectively bring a claim to court, mainly because it would be too expensive for each individual shareholder to launch their own lawsuit.

ClassActionNumber.name: Class Action Number
ClassActionNumber.definition: Reference assigned by a court to a class action.

LeadPlaintiffDeadline.name: Lead Plaintiff Deadline
LeadPlaintiffDeadline.definition: Last day an investor can become a lead plaintiff.

CourtApprovalDate.name: Court Approval Date
CourtApprovalDate.definition: Date upon which the High Court provided approval.

FilingDate.name: Filing Date
FilingDate.definition: Date on which the action was filed at the applicable court.

HearingDate.name: Hearing Date
HearingDate.definition: Date for the hearing between the plaintiff and defendant, as set by the court.

ClaimPeriod.name: Claim Period
ClaimPeriod.definition: Period assigned by the court in a class action. It determines the client's eligible transactions that will be included in the class action and used to determine the resulting entitlement.

CorporateEvent.name: Corporate Event
CorporateEvent.definition: Corporate event for which class action is specified.
